verdict.rationale: A business registry could plausibly offer an API for automated filings or lookups, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive channels: the web Online Filing Centre and a PDF form by email or mail. The probe states that the registry documents no transactional API on any surface checked. The keyless CKAN API on open.canada.ca belongs to the separate national open-data portal, and nothing shows it can run registry transactions headlessly or in CI.
